notes.title: A Major Update for Anathyma is now live!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to drop the first major update for Anathyma, and it’s a big one. You can now jump into online co-op with up to 8 players, unlock Steam Achievements, and climb the Leaderboards to show off your skills.
To make things even more fun, we’ve added a character customization menu, perfect for putting your own flair on your hero in those wild multiplayer lobbies.
The interface has also been revamped, with sleeker menus, a cleaner HUD, and unit outlines that make everything feel sharper and easier to read.
And finally, we’ve added the new Height system to gameplay. Take the high ground and gain an edge, literally, when fighting enemies from above.
